[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]

[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]

I'm not an alchemist or a wizard to create something from nothing.

[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]

I'm going to stay here for a while so take your time.

[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I hope this will be useful to you. Don't forget to wear it while fighting to get your Pumpkin Pies.

[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
I guess that I should get back to my research.

[Pumpkin Hat Researcher]
Bye, until we'll see each other again.
I wish you well...
